levels.name: Liter Boost
levels.description:
■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the number of times entered. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:
Once: <word_group=10031>Cooldown</word_group> of Burst Skill ▼ 2.34 sec.
Twice: <word_group=10031>Cooldown</word_group> of Burst Skill ▼ 2.7 sec.
Three times: <word_group=10031>Cooldown</word_group> of Burst Skill ▼ 3.17 sec.</color>
■ Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the number of times used. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:
Once: Max Ammunition Capacity ▲ 7.05% for 5 sec.
Twice: Critical Damage ▲ 3.36% for 5 sec.
Three times: ATK ▲ 5.05% for 5 sec.</color>

lines.text: There's nothing Raze & Rebuild can't do!
Oh, that? Name's Volt. Pretty cute, huh?
Give me a shout if you've got anything that needs fixin'. I can make plenty of stuff too!
Good thing you always know what I am thinking, Greenhorn.
Before I go, I want to leave behind a legacy that matters.
Wanna take Volt for a walk? We can talk along the way.
Helloooo, anybody home? Let's get going!
Greenhorn, don't forget to keep your room nice and tidy!
What a dump! It'll take me forever to fix all of this.
Stop by the workshop whenever you've got a spare minute. You can always find us there.
This place is perfect for Volt! Plenty of space to run around in.
Let me know if you want anything. I can make it for you.
I didn't know it was possible to make such progress at this age!
I'm still in my prime, baby!
... Why can't I grow taller?
I can't remember the last time I got a gift from someone.
Greenhorn, you really should learn how to handle your money better.
You didn't have to do this, but... thanks anyway.
Hmm... I didn't think someone my age could feel this way. It's... kinda nice.
So you know how to respect your elders after all!
They say kindness trumps all evil, so maybe I should pay more attention to you, you little rascal.
I may not be the best, but I can at least crack a few skulls!
Standing by.
Let's go, Volt.
Ugh! Do I have to fight?
Whatever, I'll just do what I can.
Volt! Follow me.
No need to fear, Liter is here!
I need to reload!
Lay off the tongue, Volt!
Let me see... Am I doing it right?
Volt! Let's go!
Woooo!!
Go, boys!!
Good!
Haha!
Did you see that?
Ah!
Uh...
Oh my!
Ouch... I may have gone a bit overboard...
One more victory for Volt and me!
Mighty Tools is just as mighty by the seaside!

Volt wears a life vest whenever we're near the ocean.
You should do the same, Greenhorn.
Who put fish in my toolbox?!
Thanks to you, Greenhorn, I finally got to visit the ocean.

Life is so unpredictable.
Who would have thought the day would come when I'd be wearing a swimsuit?

Let's weave a net.
I'll catch you a netful of fish!
Are you just going to stay on the shore and watch the water?

It's weird not having any work to do.
I guess this is what people mean when they say 'R&R'.

Is the swimming pool working properly?
Is there anything that needs repairing?

It's summer all right!
It's getting much warmer.
It's much cooler here, compared to the ocean up on the surface.

If a cool summer is what you're after, let me know.
I can make anything.
Thanks for the pick-me-up! This way, I won't get heatstroke again.
I'm ready to go for a dip now, thanks.
Thanks for everything you're doing, Greenhorn. I know today's a real scorcher.
A gift? ... Thank you.
When did you find time to get these?

Thank you for the gift...
But don't just think about others. Take good care of yourself, too.
Greenhorn, let's be friends forever.

I think I'm starting to have feelings for you, Greenhorn.
Let's spend next summer together as well.
This summer I've spent with you has been the best time of my life.
Are we going for a swim? Sure, let's go!
Did you call me?
Swimming sure can tucker you out.
Hmm... I don't think this'll proceed terribly smoothly.
It doesn't matter how hot it gets, I'll always succeed.
Volt, finish this and hurry to the sea.
I don't think I'll ever get used to fighting.
Aw jeez, Volt, you're all wet.
Why do you keep licking my hands? Do they smell like fish?
This scorching heat is making my memory fuzzy.
Greenhorn!
Toward the sea! Woof-woof!
Let's have fun, guys!
Take this!
It worked!
I did it!
Gah!
Arrgh!
Ouch.
I guess water and I just don't get along.
Volt! We won again!

Hey, check it out!
Volt and I have matching outfits.

You told me to wear something formal...
but why do I look like a child? I'm not into this at all.

No matter what I wear,
it won't tarnish Mighty Tools' impeccable reputation.

Sunflowers remind me of Volt, so I like them.
Actually... they're a bit like you, too.

You say I look like a kindergartener?
You take that back!

I never thought that one day I would dress like this.
I must have lived too long.

I'll leave you to your work then.
I told Centi she should come see Volt's new outfit.

I wanna go play with Volt while I'm wearing a cute outfit.
I'll be back when you're free.
Volt, do you want to go on a walk with the new clothes?

Wearing this to the Workshop may be a bit...
What do you think, Greenhorn?

Is there a kindergarten in the Outpost? Of course not. 
... Why do you ask?

Dressing like this is a bit embarrassing,
but doesn't it match perfectly with Volt?
Thank you for looking after me.
I think I've got the strength to hold on a little longer now.
Thanks to you, Greenhorn, I can have some fun for once.
You're always sending me such wonderful gifts. Thank you so much.

Another gift?
What if I were to tell you I want even more?
Is it just me, or do I get the impression that you're giving presents to a small child?

Greenhorn, I'm making a Volt badge for you.
I'll give it to you next time we see each other.

I wish you'll lead a long, long life.
That way, I can see you more.
The more I think about it, the more I'm into you.
You want me to fight in this outfit?
Go ahead.
There's no way I can run in this thing.
This isn't going smoothly at all!
Let's get this over with and hurry back.
A new outfit for a new fight! Go get 'em, Volt!
Another battle? I just finished dressing up.
Stop licking me, Volt! I'm not even wearing a helmet...
Why are you so obsessed with licking my hair?
Fighting is tougher. I must be getting old.
Volt!
Woo-hoo!! Let's have a party!
Now! Everyone!
Let's do it again!
Did I catch it?
Yeah!
Oof!
Argh!
You tore my outfit!
Fighting dressed up like this is impossible.
How do you like that? A grand victory!
